diagnosis.orchestration_failure: Run 33030061655 was dispatched to the evaluation lane after it had already reached DONE status in cycle 7. The supervisor dispatched to a lane whose state already had cycle_status=COMPLETED, continue_recommended=false, and next_recommendation=DONE.
diagnosis.root_cause: The factory supervisor lacks a check for lane completion status before dispatching. Once a lane reaches DONE with continue_recommended=false, subsequent dispatches should be blocked or redirected to the Factory Director for a successor question.
diagnosis.resolution: No durable delta needed. Lane was already complete. Snapshot made audit-ready by: (1) re-running cycle 7 to verify reproducibility (pass/fail patterns confirmed), (2) confirming all evidence_refs exist, (3) adding this audit gate to audit_refs, (4) updating github_run in state.

known_defects.description: bench_legal_area() in run_cycle_6.py and run_cycle_7.py omits metric='cosine' and linkage='average' (used in run_cycle_5.py), defaulting to Euclidean/Ward. Affects cross-cycle NMI comparability but not cycle 7 internal validity.
known_defects.note: Known limitation documented. Cycle 5 results use cosine/average; cycle 6+ results use Euclidean/Ward. Cross-cycle NMI values are not directly comparable. Within-cycle comparisons are valid.
